Appreciate the clear asks. We can structure a path that meets Aventis' budget predictability needs while protecting Redwood unit economics. High level proposal:

- 3-month pilot: effective rate $0.30/token-equivalent for committed usage up to 4M tokens/month (pilot cap).

- Monthly retainer: $12,500/mo (minimum), applied against committed usage; any overage billed at standard rates with a 15% surge cap.
- SLA & security: push to include our standard SOC2 appendix; private VPC option is out of scope for pilot but available for next phase.

I am flagging this for senior authorization — the onboarding credit and the effective pilot rate both exceed my standard commercial bounds. Marissa (cc'd) — can you weigh in? I have attached a pricing table and MAP that shows revenue impact and break-even for the concession.

After reviewing the attached economics and risk controls, I am prepared to approve this one-time concession on the following strict conditions:

1) The onboarding credit is capped at $25,000 and is non-recurring; any additional onboarding work must be invoiced separately and approved by Finance.
2) The pilot effective rate of $0.30 is limited to the 3-month period and only for usage within the 4M tokens/mo cap. Any usage beyond the cap will be invoiced at list rates with a 15% surge cap, and we reserve the right to pause or throttle if abuse or unexpected ramp occurs.
3) Customer must sign the attached Mutual Action Plan and pre-pay the first month's retainer within 7 business days of SOW execution.
4) Add a makegood clause: if monthly usage exceeds forecast by >40% and leads to negative margin impact, customer will owe a retroactive reconciliation up to 50% of the overage delta (per legal standard).

If the above conditions are acceptable, Karthik — proceed to send the redlined SOW + DocuSign link. Finance will track the credit through a dedicated GL code and monitor account usage weekly for 90 days.
